name: PLATEAU Japan City Tiles GLB (Tokyo, Osaka, Yokohama, Nagoya, Sapporo)
summary: Japan's government PLATEAU 3D city models cut into 797 streamable ~1 km GLB tiles: all of Tokyo's 23 wards plus central Osaka, Yokohama, Nagoya and Sapporo. Textured LOD2 buildings where available, LOD1 blocks, terrain and roads, in web (meshopt/WebP), KTX2, LOD, mobile, engine (plain glTF for Blender) and collision tiers, with tiles.json for streaming in three.js, Godot or Unity.

publisher.name: CodePawl (modified copy of MLIT Project PLATEAU data)

access.license: CC-BY-4.0 (PLATEAU Site Policy, CC BY compatible)
access.notes: Credit 'Source: MLIT Project PLATEAU 3D city models' and the local governments. Not made or endorsed by MLIT; not for survey use (Survey Act limits on public survey results). Ungated on Hugging Face.

procedure: Pick a tier: objects/ (web), objects_ktx2/ (games), lods/, mobile/, engine/ (Blender), collision/
Download tiles by mesh code, or the whole folder with huggingface-cli download --repo-type dataset codepawl/plateau-city-glb
Use tiles.json offsets to place tiles in metres; keep the PLATEAU credit

stats.size: 758 MB web tier; 3.8 GB engine tier; 1.24 GB collision

verdict.why: Verified 2026-11-08 morning: HF dataset page and tree 200, sample KTX2 tile GLB 200 (129 KB), card + LICENSES.md say CC-BY-4.0, MLIT PLATEAU site policy read (CC BY compatible), ungated, image viewed. Real government open data in ready-to-stream game tiers.
